hmong: Koj yog kuv tus phooj ywg mog.
english: You are my friend, you know.

hmong: Nqa lub kaus, ib tsam yuav los nag.
english: Take an umbrella, in case it rains.

hmong: Kuv nyob hauv tsev vim nag los.
english: I stay home because it is raining.

hmong: Koj xav haus dej lossis kua txiv?
english: Do you want water or juice?

hmong: Nws kawm ntawv, tsis tas li ntawd nws ua haujlwm.
english: She studies, and in addition, she works.

hmong: Txawm nag los, peb tseem mus.
english: Even though it rains, we still go.

hmong: Kuv paub tias nws nyob tom tsev.
english: I know that she is at home.

hmong: Yog hais tias nag los, peb nyob tsev.
english: If it rains, we will stay home.

hmong: Kuv tsuas haus dej xwb.
english: I only drink water.

hmong: Kuv nyiam tshuaj yej, hos nws nyiam kas fes.
english: I like tea, whereas she likes coffee.

hmong: Nws ua haujlwm tas hnub.
english: She works all day.

hmong: Kuv nyiam zaj nkauj tas los no.
english: I liked the previous song.

hmong: Koj muab phau ntawv ko rau kuv.
english: Give me that book near you.

hmong: Nws nyob ntawm ntawd tos peb.
english: He is there waiting for us.

hmong: Peb yuav tsum sib pab.
english: We should help each other.

hmong: Ob tug tub sib ntaus ntawm tsev kawm ntawv.
english: Two boys fight each other at school.

hmong: Peb zaum sib tham tom qab noj mov.
english: We sit and talk with each other after eating.

hmong: Peb sib pom txhua hnub tom haujlwm.
english: We see each other every day at work.

hmong: Peb yuav sib ntsib dua tag kis.
english: We will meet again tomorrow.

hmong: Koj tab tom ua dab tsi?
english: What are you doing?

hmong: Tus neeg ntawd yog leej twg?
english: Who is that person?

hmong: Koj nyob qhov twg?
english: Where are you?

hmong: Koj yuav tuaj thaum twg?
english: When will you come?

hmong: Koj tsis tuaj vim li cas?
english: Why did you not come?

hmong: Koj muaj menyuam pes tsawg?
english: How many children do you have?

hmong: Nws muaj ntsiab muag dub.
english: She has dark pupils.

hmong: Kuv dim muag o thaum sawv ntxov.
english: My eyelid is swollen in the morning.

hmong: Kuv lub kauj tsaim mob thaum noj mov.
english: My jaw hurts when I eat.

hmong: Kuv hniav txab tab tom loj tuaj.
english: My wisdom tooth is growing in.

hmong: Kuv pos hniav los ntshav me ntsis.
english: My gums bleed a little.

hmong: Kuv lub caj pas mob hnub no.
english: My throat hurts today.

hmong: Nws muaj kab lia ntawm ob sab plhu.
english: She has dimples on both cheeks.

hmong: Kuv xub pwg mob tom qab nqa khoom.
english: My shoulder hurts after carrying things.

hmong: Kuv caj npab mob me ntsis.
english: My arm hurts a little.

hmong: Kuv luj tshib raug mob thaum ua si.
english: My elbow was injured while playing.

hmong: Kuv ntxuav tes ua ntej noj mov.
english: I wash my hands before eating.

hmong: Kuv txiav kuv ntiv tes me ntsis.
english: I cut my finger a little.

hmong: Kuv ntiv tes xoo mob heev.
english: My thumb hurts a lot.

hmong: Kuv hauv siab mob thaum kuv khiav.
english: My chest hurts when I run.

hmong: Tus menyuam haus mis ntawm nws niam.
english: The baby breastfeeds from its mother.
note: English said 'drinks milk' — the other sense of `mis`, on a BREAST card

hmong: Tus menyuam mos muaj txiv mis me.
english: The baby has small nipples.

hmong: Kuv nrob qaum mob tom qab zaum ntev.
english: My back hurts after sitting for a long time.

hmong: Kuv quav npab mob thaum kuv txav.
english: The bend of my arm hurts when I move.

hmong: Kuv dab teg mob tom qab ntaus pob.
english: My wrist hurts after playing ball.

hmong: Kuv sab npab nqia mob tom qab nqa khoom.
english: My forearm hurts after carrying things.

hmong: Kuv sab npab ntug muaj nqaij khov.
english: My biceps are firm.

hmong: Kuv tus txha caj qaum mob heev.
english: My spine hurts a lot.

hmong: Kuv cov taubteg nyob ntawm daim iav.
english: My fingerprints are on the glass.

hmong: Kuv plab mob tom qab noj ntau.
english: My stomach hurts after eating too much.

hmong: Tus menyuam muaj ntaws me me.
english: The baby has a small belly button.

hmong: Kuv ntsag mob tom qab taug kev ntev.
english: My hip hurts after walking a long distance.

hmong: Kuv ncej puab mob tom qab khiav.
english: My thigh hurts after running.

hmong: Kuv hauv caug mob thaum nce ntaiv.
english: My knee hurts when climbing stairs.

hmong: Kuv caj hlaub mob tom qab taug kev.
english: My shin hurts after walking.

hmong: Kuv plab hlaub mob tom qab khiav.
english: My calf hurts after running.

hmong: Kuv ceg mob tom qab ua si.
english: My leg hurts after playing.

hmong: Kuv pob taws o me ntsis.
english: My ankle is a little swollen.

hmong: Kuv ko taw mob thaum taug kev.
english: My foot hurts when I walk.

hmong: Kuv ntiv taw raug mob lawm.
english: My toe is injured.

hmong: Kuv duav mob tom qab nqa khoom.
english: My waist hurts after carrying things.

hmong: Tus kws kho mob tshuaj xyuas chaw mos.
english: The doctor examines the genitals.

hmong: Kuv qhov raws mob thaum kuv zaum.
english: The bend behind my knee hurts when I sit.

hmong: Kuv ncej qab mob tom qab khiav.
english: My hamstring hurts after running.

hmong: Kuv xib taws mob thaum taug kev.
english: My heel hurts when I walk.

hmong: Kuv qab xib taws mob heev.
english: The sole of my foot hurts a lot.

hmong: Kuv plawv dhia ceev thaum khiav.
english: My heart beats fast when I run.

hmong: Kuv siab ua haujlwm zoo.
english: My liver is working well.

hmong: Kuv ntsws xav tau huab cua huv.
english: My lungs need clean air.

hmong: Tus kws kho mob kuaj kuv raum.
english: The doctor examines my kidneys.

hmong: Kuv hnyuv tsis xis nyob hnub no.
english: My intestines do not feel well today.

hmong: Tus kws kho mob kuaj kuv tsib.
english: The doctor examines my gallbladder.

hmong: Kuv hlwb xav tau sijhawm so.
english: My brain needs time to rest.

hmong: Kuv ntshav tawm me ntsis.
english: I am bleeding a little.
note: English said 'My blood is bleeding a little'

hmong: Kuv pob txha tsis muaj zog.
english: My bones are not strong.

hmong: Kuv tawv nqaij qhuav thaum caij ntuj no.
english: My skin is dry in winter.

hmong: Kuv tav mob thaum ua pa tob.
english: My rib hurts when I breathe deeply.

hmong: Kuv noj ib lub txiv es pauj.
english: I eat an apple.

hmong: Kuv noj ib lub txiv tsawb thaum sawv ntxov.
english: I eat a banana in the morning.

hmong: Peb cog noob taum lag hauv vaj.
english: We plant beans in the garden.

hmong: Cov menyuam nyiam noj txiv npaws lij.
english: The children like eating berries.

hmong: Kuv noj txiv hmab txiv ntoo txhua hnub.
english: I eat fruit every day.

hmong: Peb cog zaub hauv vaj loog.
english: We grow vegetables in the garden.

hmong: Kuv muab lub qij tso rau hauv kua zaub.
english: I put garlic in the soup.

hmong: Cov txiv as ngoos no qab heev.
english: These grapes are very tasty.

hmong: Tus nees noj quav nyab txhua hnub.
english: The horse eats hay every day.

hmong: Kuv nyem txiv maj naus ntev rau hauv dej.
english: I squeeze lemon into the water.

hmong: Kuv siv txiv maj naus pob taub ua kua txiv.
english: I use lime to make juice.

hmong: Kuv ci pob kws rau noj hmo.
english: I roast corn for dinner.

hmong: Peb cog dib txaij hauv vaj.
english: We grow melons in the garden.

hmong: Kuv khaws nceb tom hav zoov.
english: I gather mushrooms in the forest.

hmong: Kuv noj txiv plhaub tawv ua khoom txom ncauj.
english: I eat nuts as a snack.

hmong: Kuv txiav ib lub dos loj.
english: I cut a large onion.

hmong: Kuv haus kua txiv kab ntxwv thaum sawv ntxov.
english: I drink orange juice in the morning.

hmong: Kuv hau qos yaj ywm rau noj hmo.
english: I boil potatoes for dinner.

hmong: Peb ntxuav txhuv ua ntej ua mov.
english: We wash rice grains before cooking.

hmong: Peb cog quav ntsuas rau noj.
english: We grow sorghum for food.

hmong: Kuv siv taum pauv ua zaub mov.
english: I use soybeans to make food.

hmong: Kuv muab khoom rau nqaij ua ntej kib.
english: I add seasonings to the meat before frying it.

hmong: Kuv muab piam thaj rau hauv tshuaj yej.
english: I put sugar in the tea.
